content.title: Trump touts a boom in US auto plant construction, but carmakers' actions tell a different story
content.summary: (Reuters) -President Donald Trump frequently describes a booming U.S. auto industry, fueled by new factories from Canada, Mexico and Europe that he says will soon be producing American-made vehicles for global markets - from Tokyo to Paris.  A few days later, he lamented the loss of U.S. car production over the years, and proclaimed: "Car factories are coming back."  But there is little evidence of a construction binge of new U.S. car factories.
